title: Shared cause, not simple absenteeism causation
prompt: Absenteeism rose while productivity fell. Determine whether absenteeism caused the productivity decline.
facts: A facility HVAC failure closed one production wing for five days.
Employees assigned to the closed wing were coded absent unless reassigned.
Output capacity fell 24% during the closure.
Productivity returned to baseline when the wing reopened even though absenteeism remained elevated for two more days.
Unaffected facilities had no productivity decline.
